description: Haiagaru 1.6.7 pre-release: fix ChMate 242 filter-row crash caused by measuring an unattached ComposeView. Includes configurable checker toolbar buttons, filter-row height repair, Edge archive swipe navigation, legacy BE icon deduplication, and read-thread sorting improvements. Android MPP for ChMate 0.8.10.191 dev, 0.8.10.226 dev, 0.8.10.241, 0.8.10.242 dev, and 0.8.10.243 dev.
